operator_operations.the_operations_inven: Uhlu lwemisebenzi lubonakala kuphela kumsebenzi ongenile.
operator_operations.these_knobs_are_env_: Lezi zinhlabathi zifakiwe ku-env, ngakho ukufaka ukubhala kabusha ku-.env futhi kudale kabusha i-container — okungenziwa uhlelo ngokuluzenzela ngaphakathi. Umphathi ohlangothini lomphakathi ukwenza lokhu: qala i-python3 scripts/ops/infra_supervisor.py emshinini kuqala (bona incwadi yomsebenzi ye-LiveKit). Azikho izimfihlo ezingafakwa lapha.
operator_operations.waiting_for_the_host: {applyLabel} — kulindele umphathi womphakathi. Ingabe i-scripts/ops/infra_supervisor.py isebenza emshinini? — {error}
operator_roles.a_box_s_role_is_nothing_m: I-'role' yebhokisi ayikho lutho ngaphandle kwezinzalo zezinhlabathi zamandla ezilusebenzisayo. Ukwethemba lapha kuhlangene — wengeza izinhlabathi ongazisebenzisa, nganye nganye. Azikho ama-tiers okukhuphuka kuwo futhi akukho ukulanda kwesikhundla.
operator_roles.a_governed_channel_is_app: Inhlabathi ebuswayo ivunyelwa yi-dual-meter — abasebenzi ngenkathi kungekho hulumeni ohlala esihlalweni, nohulumeni ohlala esihlalweni ngomzuzu lapho eba khona — kanye ne-meter yesithathu zezinhlabathi ezimbalwa ezingena ngaphansi kwendawo yontanga. Ama-meter angezansi ayizokufunda okubukhali; akukho lapha okubala kabusha ivoti.
operator_roles.a_governed_channel_walks_: Inhlabathi ebuswayo ihamba izinyathelo ezine ezilula. Inhlabathi ezizibekela ngokwayo igxuma iye ku-Active — ayikho isicelo futhi akukho ukuvunyelwa okulindelekile.
operator_roles.a_seated_government_appro: Uhulumeni ohlala esihlalweni uvumela ngokuvota kwawo — leli bhakithi lingaqinisekisa i-Meter A kuphela, futhi isibonelelo sizala ngokucaphuna kwayo kuze kube yilapho ivoti liphumelela.
operator_roles.approval_mints_a_verified: Ukuvunyelwa kudala isibonelelo esiqinisekisiwe — imvumelwano ye-dual-meter (Art. VII ukwamukeleka; ukuthatha indawo kohulumeni ohlala esihlalweni), hhayi ukuzibeka. Ukususa eyodwa yezinhlabathi zakho kuhlala kuyisinqumo sakho sodwa.
operator_roles.four_friendly_names_group: Amagama amane ajwayelekile aqoqa izinhlabathi eziyisishiyagalolunye — akukho amandla amasha, kodwa kuwukuhlelwa nje. Ikhadi ngalinye likhombisa isetha yenhlabathi yalo, umsebenzi owuthatha, nokuthi lizivula ngokwayo noma lidinga isinqumo sikahulumeni.
operator_roles.leave_blank_for_the_root_: Shiya isikhala sendawo yegunya engumongo. Isibonelelo sisebenza endaweni — hhayi emeshini njengesikhundla.
operator_roles.no_open_role_grant_reques: Azikho izicelo zokunikeza izindima ezivulekile. Isicelo esibhekwe esivulwa nguwe noma ngomakhelwane sizovela lapha nesimo semitha saso.
operator_roles.off_the_constitutional_pl: Ngaphandle kwezinga lomthethosisekelo. Ukusebenzisa inodi kuyisisekelo, hhayi isilungelelo somuzi — akukuniki ivoti elengeziwe, isihlalo, noma ukuzwa kwesinqumo sanoma yisiphi isinqumo somthethosisekelo. Ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi angenalo uxhumano nabazisebenzi abazingane. Ungene njenge-{operator} · ukunikezwa kohlezi kuhambisana nendawo {scope} — hhayi inodi njengezikhundla.
operator_roles.open_role_grant_requests_: Izicelo zokunikeza izindima ezivulekile nezifunda zemitha yokuvuma ezisebenza
operator_roles.qualify_probes_whether_th: I-Qualify ihlolwa ukuthi le bhokisi ingaba yisikhungo seshannel yini — lokhu akushintshi lutho. Isicelo sivula ishannel ezizibekile, noma sivula isicelo esibhekwayo ukuze imitha emibili yanqume.
operator_roles.read_write_authority_is_a: Igunya lokufunda nokubhala liqiniso mayelana nendawo — lapho ikhophi yakhona ehlala khona. Lishintsha phakathi kwezinhlangano ezivumileyo ngokwe-indawo yegunya; akusona isikhundla le bhokisi elisicela.
operator_roles.self_a_self_asserted_chan: self ishannel ezibekile · governed ishannel ebhekwayo
operator_roles.self_asserted_mesh_member: Ezizibekile (mesh.member · mirror · etl): sethulaActive — ukuchofoza kanye, akukho isivimbelo.
operator_roles.self_asserted_vs_governed: Ezizibekile vs ezibhekwayo. Ishannel ezibekile ithinta wena wedwa, ngakho iwena oyivulayo. Ishannel ebhekwayo kunikeza umsebenzi phezu kwabanye abantu noma ibhala igama ngaphansi kwezone zomakhelwane — ngakho icelwa, ayizibeki, futhi ivunyelwa imitha emibili ngezansi.
operator_roles.the_nine_capability_chann: Izishannel eziyisishiyagalolunye zamandla, uhlobo lokuvuma kwazo, isimo esikhona kule nodi, nezenzo
operator_roles.the_roles_board_is_shown_: Ibhodi yezindima ibonakala kuphela kumsebenzisi ongene. Ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi ahlala ezingeni labasebenzisi — angenalo uxhumano nabazisebenzi abazingane futhi angenalo amandla ezisebenzi.
operator_roles.the_whole_closed_vocabula: Isilulumagama esivalekile sonke. Izishannel ezintathu zizibekile — mesh.member, mirror, kanye ne-etl — futhi azidingi isivimbelo nakancane: zichaza kuphela lokho okwenziwa ibhokisi lakho. Ezinye ezisithupha zibhekwayo, ngoba ngayinye inikeza umsebenzi phezu kwabanye, noma ibeka igama ngaphansi kwezone zomakhelwane.
operator_roles.this_channel_acts_under_a: Le shannel isebenza ngaphansi kwezone zomakhelwane — omakhelwane abathintekayo kumele bavume futhi (Imitha C).
operator_roles.waiting_on_the_dual_meter: Kulindele imitha emibili — bheka uhlu olulindile ngezansi.
operator_roles.you_are_the_founding_oper: Ungumsebenzisi osungulayo. Ayikho i-mesh okumele uphelele kuyo futhi akukho hulumeni ohleli esihlalweni okwamanje, ngakho yonke indima ingeyakho ukuyivula ngqo — kuhlanganise nezishannel ezibhekwayo. Uma umhlaba wakho usungulwe futhi uhulumeni uhleli esihlalweni, izishannel ezibhekwayo zibuyela endleleni yokuvuma kwemitha emibili kunoma yikuphi ukushintsha okuzayo.
operator_versioning.a_and_b_are_two_legs: A no B zingamagatsha amabili esihlalo esisodwa — ibhodi yabasebenzisi ifakazela kuphela ngenkathi kungekho hulumeni ohleli esihlalweni; ngomzuzu lapho omunye ehleli khona, iningi lakhe elikhethekile lithatha indawo yebhodi. C ngumakhelwane wonke othiwe uthembekile obamba ikhophi yasekhaya yendawo ethintekayo (ukuvumelana kwabo bonke; idlula ngokwayo lapho kungekho umakhelwane onjalo).
operator_versioning.a_divergent_version_: Inguqulo ehlukile imisa ukuhambisana kunokuhlanganisa ngokuthula imithetho engahambisani. Uhlangothi olunye luvuma ukuthuthukiswa — ngemitha efanayo ngezansi — ngaphambi kokuba imininingwane yalo iqhubeke.
operator_versioning.a_proposal_is_screen: Isiphakamiso sihlolwa kuqala, sivunyelwe okwesibili. Imitha yonke esebenza kumele idlule; imitha engasebenzi ohlobo lwesiphakamiso noma ubude bayo ayidingeki.
operator_versioning.a_running_election_o: Ukhetho noma iseshini esiqhubekayo sigcina inguqulo yaso.
operator_versioning.answerable_to_the_go: Kuphendula kuhulumeni. Abasebenzisi baqhuba ukuthuthukiswa; abalobi mithetho. Isihlolo siqinile, ukuvimba kuyizimo zombuliso, futhi uhulumeni ohleli esihlalweni unegama lokugcina.
operator_versioning.every_peer_advertise: Wonke ontanga bamemezela uhlobo lwabo lomthethosisekelo. Ontanga ohlobweni oluhlukile ngeke akwazi ukusingiswa — i-mesh yanqaba kuze kube yilapho omabili ohlangothi evumelane nokuthuthukiswa.
operator_versioning.every_proposal_passe: Wonke uphawu ludlula ehlolweni lokwemukeleka eliqinile ngaphambi kokuba kuvaleleke ukuvuma. Olungaphansi kokulingana, noma olwehlisa iningi elikhethekile kube ngaphansi kweningi-plus-one, luyanقaba ngokuphelele — akukho imitha, akukho ophathayo, futhi akukho amandla angalenza dlule.
operator_versioning.fail_closed_not_best: Ukuhluleka okugcina konke kuvalwe, hhayi ukuzama okungcono kakhulu.
operator_versioning.how_a_version_change: Indlela uhlobo olushintsha ngayo kwi-mesh — lokhu okuqaliswa yileli nodi, lokhu okumemezelwa yiyo yonke intanga, kanye neziphakamiso ezivulekile ezilindele ukuvuma. Konke ukushintsha komthethosisekelo kuhlolwa kuqala ihlolo eliqinile, bese kuvunyelwa ngabantu abaphethe amandla ngempela.
operator_versioning.no_meters_this_kind_: akukho mitha — lolu hlobo luhamba ngokuzenzakalela
operator_versioning.no_open_proposals_th: Azikho iziphakamiso ezivulekile — i-mesh iyavumelana ngohlobo olusebenzayo.
operator_versioning.no_peers_yet_this_bo: Akukho ontanga okwamanje — le bhokisi imile yodwa. Izinhlobo ziqala ukubaluleka ngomzuzu lapho ibhokisi lesibili lihlangana ne-mesh.
operator_versioning.off_the_constitution: Ngaphandle kwezinga lomthethosisekelo. Ukuthuthukisa isoftware kuyikhono lezinga lomphathi, hhayi isidingo somuzi. Imithetho yomthethosisekelo uqobo yona ayikaze ihlelwe lapha — ushintsho lohlobo luphakamiswa, luhlolwe, bese kuphela lapho kuvunyelwa ngabantu abaphethe amandla ngempela.
operator_versioning.pinning_is_a_pure_fu: Ukupina kuyifungshini ephelele yerekhodi yomncintiswano; akukho ukuchitha ukuvimba okwenziwa ngesandla ukuze kuvulwe umdlalo osebenza.
operator_versioning.proposed_by_node_for: kuphakamiswe yinodi {shortId} · endaweni {shortId2} · ukuvuma kuwela ku {legLabel}
operator_versioning.the_constitutional_v: uhlobo lomthethosisekelo — isigxiviso semithetho eqinile esebenzayo
operator_versioning.this_console_renders: Le konsoli ikhipha iqiniso lohlobo elibambwe isevisizi sokuvumelana nokuthuthukiswa — ayikaze iphinde ifake imitha noma ishintshe uhlobo ngokwayo. Iziphakamiso ziqhutshwa ngezinsizakalo ze-mesh; ukubuyela emuva kohlobo lomthethosisekelo ngeke kwaze kwadlula ehlolweni eliqinile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ovumayo.
operator_versioning.three_kinds_of_versi: Izinhlobo ezintathu zihamba ngokuzimela. Uhlobo lomthethosisekelo kuphela oluthinta ubuso obuqinile — lona kuphela oludlula ehlolweni nasemitheni ngaphansi; ukukhishwa kohlelo nokuthuthukiswa kwesikhala kuhamba ngokuzenzakalela.
operator_versioning.versions_and_upgrade: Izinhlobo neziphakamiso zokuthuthukiswa ziboniswa kuphela kumphathi osayine ngaphakathi. Akukho okunqunywa lapha ngaphandle kokuvuma — ushintsho lohlobo lucima imitha, hhayi ikonsoli.
operator_versioning.when_play_begins_the: Lapho ukudlala kuqala, umncintiswano ubamba uhlobo lomthethosisekelo olusebenzayo ngaleso sikhathi. Noma yikuphi ukuthuthukiswa okuvunyelwe kusebenza emncintiswanweni olandelayo — hhayi kulowo osephakathi nokudlala — ngakho akukho muntu ongashintsha imithetho ngaphansi kwamaphepha lokuvota asevele wavotwa.
